svg.title: Hybrid islandable microgrid — Local solar and engine sources
svg.desc: Local solar and engine sources. 9 equipment references and 8 declared directed connections. Static illustrative symbols; arrows do not show instantaneous flow. This selected view does not include every plant connection.
